class.name: GodotDoctorPlugin
class.brief_description: Godot Doctor - A plugin to validate node and resource configurations in the Godot Editor. Author: CodeVogel (https://codevogel.com/) Repository: https://github.com/codevogel/godot_doctor Report issues or feature requests at https://github.com/codevogel/godot_doctor/issues License: MIT

method.name: _enter_tree
method.description: Called when the plugin enters the scene scene_tree. Initializes the plugin by connecting signals and adding the dock to the editor, or running in CLI mode when headless.

method.name: _initialize_for_any_mode
method.description: Shared initialization for any [enum RunMode].

method.name: _initialize_for_editor_mode
method.description: Initialization specific to [enum RunMode.EDITOR].

method.name: _initialize_for_cli_mode
method.description: Initialization specific to [enum RunMode.CLI].

method.name: _enable_plugin
method.description: Called when the plugin is enabled by the user through Project Settings > Plugins. Displays a welcome dialog if configured in settings.

method.name: _disable_plugin
method.description: Called when the plugin is disabled by the user through Project Settings > Plugins.

method.name: _exit_tree
method.description: Called when the plugin exits the scene scene_tree. Cleans up the plugin by disconnecting signals and removing the dock.

method.name: _teardown
method.description: Tears down the plugin by cleaning up threads and signal connections.

method.name: _connect_and_track
method.description: Connect a [param signal_to_connect_to] to a [param callable_to_execute] and track the connection for later disconnection.

method.name: _disconnect_all_tracked_signals
method.description: Disconnects all tracked signals in [member _signal_connections] and clears the list.

method.name: _connect_signals
method.description: Connects all necessary signals for the plugin to function.

method.name: _connect_runner_signals
method.description: Connects signals specific to the active runner.

method.name: _connect_editor_runner_signals
method.description: Connects signals specific to the editor runner (for [RunMode.EDITOR]).

method.name: _connect_cli_runner_signals
method.description: Connects signals specific to the CLI runner (for [RunMode.CLI]).

method.name: _connect_validator_signals
method.description: Connects signals emitted by the validator during validation runs.

method.name: _disconnect_signals
method.description: Disconnects all connected signals to avoid dangling connections.

method.name: _on_scene_saved
method.description: Called when a scene is saved by the user; triggers validation if [member GodotDoctorSettings.validate_on_save] is enabled.

method.name: _on_run_complete
method.description: Called when the runner signals that the entire validation run is complete.

method.name: _report_on_collected_results_for_editor
method.description: Processes the collected validation results and generates reports for editor mode.

method.name: _report_on_collected_results_for_cli
method.description: Processes the collected validation results and generates reports for CLI mode. Returns [code]true[/code] if validation passed, [code]false[/code] if validation failed.

method.name: quit_with_code
method.description: Quits the editor with the given [param exit_code].

method.name: quit_with_fail_early_if_headless
method.description: Quits the editor with a failure code if running in headless mode.

method.name: _set_window_layout
method.description: Called by the editor on startup. We use this hook to start the CLI runner thread once the editor is ready.

method.name: _start_cli_thread
method.description: Starts the CLI runner thread if it hasn't been started yet, and kicks off the quit fallback timer.

method.name: _start_cli_start_fallback_timer
method.description: Creates and starts the start fallback timer using [method SceneTree.create_timer]. When it times out, it posts the semaphore so the runner thread can proceed even if [method _set_window_layout] was never called.

method.name: _on_cli_start_fallback_timeout
method.description: Called when the start fallback timer expires. Posts the semaphore so the runner thread is unblocked even without [method _set_window_layout] having been called.

method.name: _start_cli_quit_fallback_timer
method.description: Creates and starts the quit fallback timer using [method SceneTree.create_timer]. When it times out, the process is force-quit with exit code 1.

method.name: _on_cli_quit_fallback_timeout
method.description: Called when the quit fallback timer expires. Force-quits the process because the CLI runner took too long.

method.name: validate_scene_root_and_edited_resource
method.description: Validation entry point for both the current scene root and edited resource. Useful when you want to validate from some external trigger like an [EditorScript] NOTE: This should only be used in editor mode, as it relies on the editor runner.

method.name: _show_welcome_dialog
method.description: Shows the welcome dialog on first plugin enable.

members.member: Singleton instance of the plugin for global access if needed. Avoid using this directly in most cases. This can, however, be useful for starting validation from external scripts such as the Dock's 'Validate Now' button.
Internal backing field for the singleton instance of the plugin. Use [member instance] for global access instead of using this field directly.
A Resource that holds the settings for the Godot Doctor plugin.
The current mode in which the plugin is running, determined at runtime based on the environment.
The update checker responsible for checking for plugin updates on startup and notifying the user.
The validator responsible for executing validation logic on nodes and resources.
The runner responsible for executing validation in the editor environment.
The collector responsible for gathering validation results during a run.
The reporter responsible for generating reports from collected validation results.
Thread that the CLI runner runs on. Only created when the editor signals readiness or a fallback timer fires.
Internal backing field for the current mode in which the plugin is running.
Stores all active signal connections as [Signal, Callable] pairs for later disconnection.

signal.name: validation_complete
signal.description: Emitted when validation is complete. In Headless mode, this signals the CLI reporter to exit the process. In Editor mode, this can be used to trigger any post-validation actions.

constants.constant: The path of the settings resource used to configure the plugin.

constant.name: PLUGIN_WELCOME_MESSAGE
constant.value:
"Godot Doctor is ready! 👨🏻‍⚕️🩺
The plugin has succesfully been enabled. You'll now see the Godot Doctor dock in your editor.
You can change its default position in the settings resource (addons/godot_doctor/settings).
You can also disable this dialog there.
Basic usage instructions are available in the README or on the GitHub repository.
NOTE: If you happen to use the non-mono version of godot, and are getting C# related warning messages, you can safely delete the 'addons/godot_doctor/core/c_sharp' directory.
Please report any issues, bugs, or feature requests on GitHub.
Happy developing!
- CodeVogel 🐦"
